criteria.evidence_rule: Bind publisher repository, exact revision, license, byte size, digest, redistribution, retention, training, private-upload, and publication restrictions before selection.
Execute a full known-room survey before close-ups and retain explicit unseen, uncaptured, occluded, and unrenderable-region disclosures.
Resolve external and wrist policy views plus a review-only overview; the overview is forbidden from policy input and deterministic scoring.
The two tasks must bind different source instances, mask sets, collider subtrees, collider deletions, replacement assets, qualifications, and task-specific assumptions.
Materialize exact InteriorGS bytes and bind full-retention reconnaissance separately from later evaluation-authorized rendering.
Observed appearance must support a bounded controllable resettable scoreable mechanism; generated hidden geometry is labeled candidate content, never observed truth.
Bind a distinct freestanding rigid source object, support, start state, destination or target pose range, and deterministic release-settle predicate.
Resolve separate bases and prove base, approach, contact, path, release, retreat, recovery, limits, containment, penetration, and reset gates without moving unrelated geometry.
Open the exact SAGE collision stage, bind its digest, and require a unique separately removable whole-source collider subtree for each task.
Prove or explicitly abstain on InteriorGS-to-SAGE frame, metric scale, axes, handedness, source-to-world, and asset-to-world transforms.
Observed collision and appearance must bind attachment or support geometry plus a collision-qualified destination volume, pose range, or target joint set.
Both task objects must originate in publisher observations and require independent source removal and replacement pipelines.
